metadata.description: Validation test for a GPS Rescue started inside min_start_dist (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T12b): about 5 m from home at 12 s, the rescue climbs to max(10 m, current + 10 m) while pitching 15° forward, turns home once beyond 15 m, starts its descent 7.5 m out, lands near home and disarms on impact.
